sections.content: Akhil Bharatiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad (A.B.M.S Parishad), an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. It was established in 1907 with the thought “Bahujan Hitay, Bahujan Sukhaya”. In the first half of the 20th century A.B.M.S. Parishad made a commendable contribution of awakening and inspiring the masses who were deprived of education for generations. Owing to its inspiration, large number of educational institution were established throughout Maharashtra and outside Maharashtra. A.B.M.S Parishad draws its inspiration from Mahatma Phule, Rajashri Shahu Maharaj, the Ruler of Kolhapur and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar who fought for economic, social and political justice and advocated empowerment of economically and socially disadvantaged section of the society.

sections.heading: 189 Km from Mumbai.
sections.content:
The institute is situated in the area of 10 acres of land surrounded by beautiful landscape of Sahyadri Hills of Western Ghats nearing to famous Parvati Hills. Site is surrounded by lush of green and scenic beauty, fresh air, free from pollution and abandoned water supply. This site is an attractive place for visitors when beautification of campus completed.
The Pune city is known as “Oxford of East” is knowledge capital of our country. The city is blessed with rich, cultural and academic heritage. The city is covering, Engineering, Automobile, Pharmacy besides premier I.T. establishments. The premier industries consist of Tata Motors, Bajaj Auto, Force & Bharat Forge and I.T. Industries namely Infosys, T.C.S., Cognizant, Wipro and many more.  In addition to theses, numerous small scale industries, opening wide area of employment opportunities to the local people. Besides more and more multinational industrial offices are being set up throughout industrial belt of Pune.
We at A.B.M.S.P. are committed to bridge the gap between the institute and industrial visits, training programmes, projects and campus placements.

### About A.B.M.S.Parishad
Akhil Bharatiya Maratha Shikshan Parishad (A.B.M.S Parishad), an educational trust was founded by a team of renowned educationists and social reformers. It was established in 1907 with the thought “Bahujan Hitay, Bahujan Sukhaya”. In the first half of the 20th century A.B.M.S. Parishad made a commendable contribution of awakening and inspiring the masses who were deprived of education for generations. Owing to its inspiration, large number of educational institution were established throughout Maharashtra and outside Maharashtra. A.B.M.S Parishad draws its inspiration from Mahatma Phule, Rajashri Shahu Maharaj, the Ruler of Kolhapur and Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar who fought for economic, social and political justice and advocated empowerment of economically and socially disadvantaged section of the society.

- 4 Km from Deccan Gymkhana,
- 189 Km from Mumbai.

This site is an attractive place for visitors when beautification of campus completed.
The Pune city is known as “Oxford of East” is knowledge capital of our country. The city is blessed with rich, cultural and academic heritage. The city is covering, Engineering, Automobile, Pharmacy besides premier I.T. establishments. The premier industries consist of Tata Motors, Bajaj Auto, Force & Bharat Forge and I.T. Industries namely Infosys, T.C.S., Cognizant, Wipro and many more.  In addition to theses, numerous small scale industries, opening wide area of employment opportunities to the local people. Besides more and more multinational industrial offices are being set up throughout industrial belt of Pune.
